g.title: HR_LEARNERCOSTS
g.text: Learner Costs - This entity contains the costs related to a learner.
The currency of the course cost.
This field containes the cost amount.
The amount expressed in System Currency.
The adjusted cost amount, in the selected currency.
Adjusted Cost Amount, in System Currency.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_LEARNER
g.text: Learner - This is the entity representing a person enrolled or candidate to a course.
The identifier of the company relationship record.
A reference to a Training Session.
This field contains the code of the learner.
Displays the person's name and the session code.
The reason why a Learner was enrolled on a Session.
This is a note/comment related to the learner.
This is a note to justify, for example, a rejection of the enrolment.
This is the status of the Learner, from a choice of Candidate, Enrolled, In Wait List or Cancelled.
This is the completion status of the Learner.
This is the source who the learner has been proposed as candidated by.
This is the source who the learner hase been enrolled by.
Indicates if the Learning was completed successfully.
Activate this flag to mark this Training resource as required for compulsory training. For example, to renew or take a certification/qualification.
Average score coming from all scored activities.
The date when the person became a candidate for the course.
Indicates the enrol date of learner.
The date and time when the Learner started the activity.
The date and time when the Learner completed the course.
This indicates when the learner was added to waiting list.
The number of absences that a learner took, if applicable.
The unit of measure for total absences.
Identifier of a 5-levels rating scale value.
Indicates the learner's progress in a session.
This is the number of activities completed by a Learner.
This is the average score for all Test/Quiz activities for a given learner.
This field is used to categorise the learner.
This field indicates the type of financing
Indicates if an e-Mail for inviting the Learner has been sent.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

Currency of the actual cost financing.
